statement: Decisions to report cooldown, rate and capacity refusals are separated by at least one monotonic second; each report generates at most one line per category. Fixed-size reporting state retains the difference between cumulative and reported counters, including across empty/error polls. For each category, generated report totals plus pending deltas equal its cumulative counter before saturation. A report decision clears pending deltas; filtered or delayed writes do not change accounting.
